description: Bicycle routes, including informal, on-road and off-road routes. is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Melbourne Open Data. This dataset represents the bicycle routes within the municipal boundary of the City of Melbourne. Coverage: City of Melbourne Open Data. The portal files it under the publisher City of Melbourne Open Data. Its tags are bicycle, bike, cityreactivation, itshack, movement. It offers 5 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, JSON, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
